ui_bugs.issue: When navigating from #/payment/callback (no reference) to #/payment/callback?reference=TEST_FAKE_REF in the SAME page without a full reload, GoRouter re-uses the existing State so initState does not re-run; the old 'Missing payment reference.' message remains even though 'Reference: TEST_FAKE_REF' is now rendered below. Fresh page load with the fake reference shows the correct 'We could not verify this payment' message. Low priority (users land here via Paystack external redirect, which is always a fresh load), but worth guarding against by keying the screen on the reference value or using didUpdateWidget.

action_items: (Optional/low) Rebuild OwnerPaymentCallbackScreen when the reference query param changes within the same session so an SPA-side hash navigation picks up the new ref (currently only matters if the UI itself navigates between the two forms of the callback URL; the real-world Paystack redirect is always a fresh page load and works correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: Flutter semantics requires activating via 'Enable accessibility' (click on flt-semantics-placeholder). This is a Flutter-web limitation; already noted in iter 9. The semantics labels for the whistle button DO flip between 'Alert whistle on' and 'Alert whistle off', which is correct.

/signin deep link still returns 'Route unavailable' (GoException: no routes for location: /signin). Login is only reachable from the top-right 'Sign in' button on the landing page (same note as iter 9).
After login, 7+ background requests return 401 in console (notifications poll etc.) which do not break the UI but are noisy; worth investigating if these are stale tokens being retried.
